commits.message:
fix: handle edge cases in config parser gracefully

When the configuration file is empty, has unreadable permissions, or
contains type-mismatched values that prevent deserialization, the parser
now emits a warning (eprintln) and falls back to safe defaults instead
of failing silently.

fix: resolve pre-existing compile errors in main.rs

Fix 7 pre-existing compile errors:
- Replace undefined "diagnostic" references with "message" (3x)
- Replace undefined "span_obj" with "primary_span"
- Replace undefined "msg_text" with "diagnostic_message"
- Add missing "rules" field to SarifToolDriver
- Fix SarifRun.results type from Vec<Value> to Vec<SarifResult>
